title: Prom and Homecoming
author: Sable Sandoval
blurb: Ulyana Brightwater, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
